summary: Aketi territory in western Bas-Uele has no reported armed-group presence as of 2026; the LRA/Mbororo-related insecurity of the 2010s affected mainly northern Bas-Uele (Ango, Bondo) and the current ADF expansion is in Haut-Uele. The territory is under ordinary state administration: the PNC holds Aketi town (territorial seat) and the larger villages of the Aketi and Likati secteurs, with small FARDC detachments. Assessments are default state presence, with low-to-medium confidence for rural villages given sparse reporting.

zones.evidence: Searches (FR/EN, 2025-2026) found no reports of armed-group activity in Aketi territory; recent Uele insecurity (ADF expansion) is concentrated in Haut-Uele (Watsa, Wamba), far to the east. News from Aketi concerns administration, infrastructure and health, consistent with normal state administration. Aketi is the seat of the territorial administration with PNC commissariat.
